In regards to $TRUMP:

Think midcurves think you have to rotate out of this eventually. 

In reality I think this becomes the new liquid trading venue for Trump-related speculation (replacing $DJT). 

It also becomes our first real memecoin normie onboarder since $DOGE.

In 2021, $DOGE added over $70B to its market cap in one month. 

That marked the 7th/8th inning of the cycle. 

$TRUMP just did that in one night. https://t.co/IdAcrWB4TN

Tokens I would love to see @sershokunin and @hyperunit list as an hl spot user:

- $DOGE
- $XRP
- $TRX
- $SUI
- $TAO

I would have probably bought some of these spot at some point if they were easier to find.
